title: Ashlin Barry’s Audacious U23 Worlds Win Proves the Power of Aero in Modern Cycling
content:
While Barry's win was massively impressive, his aero expertise and the new rules of hyper-fast road cycling show just how much cycling tactics continue to change.

Read the full article at Ashlin Barry’s Audacious U23 Worlds Win Proves the Power of Aero in Modern Cycling on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
